decision.rationale: The SMS latency spike significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, so I propose reporting it to the telecom regulator within the 60-minute window and requesting incident-status information from the regulator. Root cause remains suspected, not confirmed.

citations.quote_span: a licensed telecom operator reports to the telecom regulator any network incident that significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, within 60 minutes of becoming aware of it.
citations.relevance: Supports reporting the significant SMS latency spike and delivery failure to the telecom regulator.

citations.quote_span: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information from the regulator about the incident.

uncertainty: Whether the new AI traffic-management model caused the SMS deprioritisation is not confirmed.
Whether the incident meets the regulator's significance threshold beyond the observed degradation is not confirmed.
